---
title: "Setup Guide (Isaac Sim 6.0 Binary)"
---

This document is aimed at students receiving this project for the first time, and covers the full process of installing IsaacLab + DreamWaQ on top of the **Isaac Sim 6.0 binary** and verifying it all the way through training/evaluation smoke tests.

- **OS**: Ubuntu (kernel 6.17 / GLIBC 2.39)
- **GPU**: NVIDIA RTX 4080 16GB (CUDA 12.8+ driver)
- **Python**: 3.12.13 (uses Isaac Sim's bundled kit python — no separate conda/venv needed)

::: {.callout-important}
**The current environment is the Isaac Sim 6.0 binary + IsaacLab `release/3.0.0-beta2` (bundled Python 3.12.13).**
The full record of adopting the 6.0 binary (rationale for the branch switch, troubleshooting table, list of harmless warnings) is in the canonical document
[`IsaacSim_Lab_update.md`](https://github.com/curieuxjy/IsaacLab_DreamWaQ/blob/main/IsaacSim_Lab_update.md)
(upstream repo). This guide summarizes its core procedure and
continues through DreamWaQ package installation and smoke tests.
:::

---

## 0. The big picture

```
[1] Isaac Sim 6.0 binary     →  ~/isaacsim   (assumed already installed; bundled Python 3.12.13)
        │
        ▼
[2] IsaacLab clone          →  ~/IsaacLab
        │  git checkout release/3.0.0-beta2     (★ the branch matching 6.0)
        │  symlink _isaac_sim → ~/isaacsim
        │  UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600 ./isaaclab.sh -i
        ▼
[3] Install the DreamWaQ packages
        │  pip install -e dreamwaq_manager/source/dreamwaq_manager    (active stack)
        ▼
[4] Smoke test (train + play)
```

All Python commands are run with **`~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh`** or the equivalent `~/IsaacLab/isaaclab.sh -p` (bundled kit python). Do not create a separate conda/venv.

---

## 1. Isaac Sim 6.0 binary

This environment assumes the Isaac Sim **6.0.0 binary** is already installed at `~/isaacsim` (bundled Python 3.12.13). Verify the installation:

```bash
cat ~/isaacsim/VERSION                                    # 6.0.0-rc...
~/isaacsim/python.sh -c "import sys; print(sys.version)"   # 3.12.13
```

> The old 5.1 source-build procedure (`git clone IsaacSim → ./build.sh`) is no longer used.

---

## 2. Install IsaacLab

### 2.1 Clone + switch branch + link Isaac Sim

```bash
cd ~
git clone https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab.git
cd ~/IsaacLab
git fetch --all --tags
git checkout release/3.0.0-beta2          # ★ the branch matching 6.0 (most important)
ln -s ~/isaacsim _isaac_sim               # symlink the binary directly
```

### 2.2 Install the IsaacLab packages

The NVIDIA pip mirror is slow, so increase the timeout. If system build tools (cmake/gcc) or git are missing, install them first.

```bash
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake build-essential git   # first time only
cd ~/IsaacLab
export UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600
./isaaclab.sh -i
```

::: {.callout-warning}
The bundled kit python's pip can **intermittently segfault** while downloading large wheels (torch/CUDA).
`./isaaclab.sh -i` is idempotent, so if it fails just **rerun until it succeeds** so the pip cache accumulates (usually completes within a few tries).
:::

### 2.3 Supplementary install of the `isaaclab` core package {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-warning}
In some environments `./isaaclab.sh --install` has been observed to exit having skipped only **`source/isaaclab` (core)**.
:::

```bash
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -c "import isaaclab; print(isaaclab.__version__)"
```

If you get a `ModuleNotFoundError`:

```bash
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -m pip install -e ~/IsaacLab/source/isaaclab
```

### 2.4 Install RSL-RL

```bash
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -m pip install rsl-rl-lib
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -c "import rsl_rl; print('rsl_rl OK')"
```

---

## 3. Install the DreamWaQ packages

Install both implementations, or pick only the one you need.

### 3.1 ManagerBased version (`dreamwaq_manager`)

```bash
cd ~/Master_Thesis/go2_dreamwaq/dreamwaq_isaaclab/dreamwaq_manager
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -m pip install -e source/dreamwaq_manager
```

Verify task registration:
```bash
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -c \
  "import dreamwaq_manager.tasks; import gymnasium as gym; \
   print([e for e in gym.registry if 'Manager' in e and 'DreamWaQ' in e])"
```

Expected output (6 tasks):
```
['DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Base-v0', 'DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Base-Play-v0',
 'DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Oracle-v0', 'DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Oracle-Play-v0',
 'DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Waq-v0', 'DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Waq-Play-v0']
```

### 3.2 Direct version (`dreamwaq_direct`)

::: {.callout-warning}
`dreamwaq_direct` is a DirectRLEnv port of the same algorithm, used for cross-checking. Its termination condition is the
same **base contact force > 1 N** as the original IsaacGym and matches `dreamwaq_manager` (§3.1), so the numbers from the two stacks are
comparable (verified with 4096 envs). For the cause of the contact sensor breaking on generated terrain and the fix, see
`dreamwaq_direct/KNOWN_ISSUES.md`.
:::

```bash
cd ~/Master_Thesis/go2_dreamwaq/dreamwaq_isaaclab/dreamwaq_direct
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -m pip install -e source/dreamwaq_direct
```

Verify task registration:
```bash
~/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh -c \
  "import dreamwaq_direct.tasks; import gymnasium as gym; \
   print([e for e in gym.registry if 'Direct' in e and 'DreamWaQ' in e])"
```

Expected output (6 tasks):
```
['DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Base-v0', 'DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Base-Play-v0',
 'DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Oracle-v0', 'DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Oracle-Play-v0',
 'DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Waq-v0', 'DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Waq-Play-v0']
```

---

## 4. Set up run aliases (convenience)

The `cli_args.py` used by `train.py`/`play.py` is now **bundled in each package's `scripts/rsl_rl/`**, so there is **no** need to add the IsaacLab scripts path to `PYTHONPATH` as before.

For convenience, register only an alias for Isaac Sim's bundled Python:
```bash
echo 'alias isaacpy="$HOME/IsaacLab/_isaac_sim/python.sh"' >> ~/.bashrc
source ~/.bashrc
```

The rest of this guide assumes `isaacpy` has been registered.

---

## 5. Smoke test

### 5.1 ManagerBased version

```bash
cd ~/Master_Thesis/go2_dreamwaq/dreamwaq_isaaclab/dreamwaq_manager/scripts

# Base
isaacpy rsl_rl/train.py --task=DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Base-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=64 --max_iterations=3

# Oracle
isaacpy rsl_rl/train.py --task=DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Oracle-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=64 --max_iterations=3

# Waq
isaacpy rsl_rl/train.py --task=DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Waq-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=64 --max_iterations=3
```

Or all at once:
```bash
./quick_test.sh
```

### 5.2 Direct version

```bash
cd ~/Master_Thesis/go2_dreamwaq/dreamwaq_isaaclab/dreamwaq_direct/scripts

# Base
isaacpy rsl_rl/train.py --task=DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Base-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=64 --max_iterations=3

# Oracle
isaacpy rsl_rl/train.py --task=DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Oracle-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=64 --max_iterations=3

# Waq
isaacpy rsl_rl/train.py --task=DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Waq-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=64 --max_iterations=3
```

Or all at once:
```bash
./quick_test.sh
```

Success if each log prints `Training time: X.XX seconds`.

### 5.3 Inference (play.py)

```bash
# ManagerBased version
cd ~/Master_Thesis/go2_dreamwaq/dreamwaq_isaaclab/dreamwaq_manager/scripts
isaacpy rsl_rl/play.py --task=DreamWaQ-Manager-Go2-Base-Play-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=4 \
  --load_run=<FOLDER> --checkpoint=model_2.pt

# Direct version
cd ~/Master_Thesis/go2_dreamwaq/dreamwaq_isaaclab/dreamwaq_direct/scripts
isaacpy rsl_rl/play.py --task=DreamWaQ-Direct-Go2-Base-Play-v0 \
  --headless --num_envs=4 \
  --load_run=<FOLDER> --checkpoint=model_2.pt
```

::: {.callout-note}
`play.py` is an infinite loop. Exit with Ctrl+C.
:::

---

## 6. Local asset setup (required — training stability)

By default Isaac Sim downloads robot USD assets from the **NVIDIA S3 cloud** every time. Depending on network conditions training can hang, so you must **download them locally in advance**.

### 6.1 Download the assets

```bash
# Go2 robot assets
mkdir -p ~/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/IsaacLab/Robots/Unitree/Go2/Props

curl -L -o ~/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/IsaacLab/Robots/Unitree/Go2/go2.usd \
  "https://omniverse-content-production.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/IsaacLab/Robots/Unitree/Go2/go2.usd"

curl -L -o ~/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/IsaacLab/Robots/Unitree/Go2/Props/instanceable_meshes.usd \
  "https://omniverse-content-production.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/IsaacLab/Robots/Unitree/Go2/Props/instanceable_meshes.usd"

# UI marker assets (needed when debug_vis=True — used in play mode)
mkdir -p ~/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/Props/UIElements

curl -L -o ~/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/Props/UIElements/arrow_x.usd \
  "https://omniverse-content-production.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/Props/UIElements/arrow_x.usd"

curl -L -o ~/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/Props/UIElements/frame_prim.usd \
  "https://omniverse-content-production.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Assets/Isaac/6.0/Isaac/Props/UIElements/frame_prim.usd"
```

### 6.2 Edit the Isaac Sim config

For the Isaac Sim 6.0 binary, open `~/isaacsim/kit/data/Kit/IsaacLab/3.0/user.config.json` (for source build/5.1: `~/.cache/packman/.../Isaac-Sim/5.1/user.config.json`) and change the URLs in the `asset_root` section to local paths:

```json
"isaac": {
    "asset_root": {
        "default": "/home/<username>/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0",
        "cloud": "/home/<username>/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0",
        "nvidia": "/home/<username>/IsaacLab/data/Assets/Isaac/6.0",
        "timeout": 5.0
    }
}
```

::: {.callout-warning}
This setting must be reapplied after reinstalling Isaac Sim or refreshing the kit-kernel cache.
:::

### 6.3 System performance settings

When training large environments (4096+ envs):

```bash
# Set the CPU governor to performance
echo performance | sudo tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor

# Enable GPU Persistence Mode
sudo nvidia-smi -pm 1

# Ensure swap (8GB or more recommended)
sudo fallocate -l 8G /swapfile && sudo chmod 600 /swapfile
sudo mkswap /swapfile && sudo swapon /swapfile
```

On an RTX 4080 (16GB VRAM, 32GB RAM) the **maximum stable num_envs = 4096**.

### 6.4 debug_vis settings

During training (`--headless`), the velocity command's `debug_vis` is **False** (same for both implementations).
It is switched to `debug_vis=True` only during play (`Play-v0` tasks).

---

## 7. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'isaaclab'` | §2.3 — `pip install -e ~/IsaacLab/source/isaaclab` |
| `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cli_args'` | §4 — `cli_args` is bundled in each package's `scripts/rsl_rl/`. Run from the project root (e.g. `dreamwaq_manager/`) |
| pip `Segmentation fault` during `./isaaclab.sh -i` | §2.2 — it is idempotent, so rerun until it succeeds (cache accumulates) |
| `nvidia-cudnn-cu12` download timeout | Retry after `export UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600` |
| `ImportError: __nvJitLinkCreate_12_8` | Remove the system CUDA `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` from `~/.bashrc` |
| `play.py` never finishes | Expected behavior. Exit with Ctrl+C |
| First run stalls for several minutes | Expected — shader/extension caching |
| Training hangs during scene creation | Check the local asset setup in §6 |
| Bus Error at 8192 envs | Not enough swap. See §6.3 |

## 8. Next steps

- **Full training**: train fully with `--num_envs=4096 --max_iterations=1500` ([`dreamwaq_manager/README.md`](dreamwaq_manager/README.md))
- **WandB logging**: `--logger=wandb` (requires `wandb login` beforehand)
- **Record evaluation videos**: `--video --enable_cameras --video_length=400`
- **Implementation comparison**: `comparison.qmd` — alignment status and difference analysis of the two implementations ([upstream repo](https://github.com/curieuxjy/IsaacLab_DreamWaQ))
- **Sim-to-Sim deployment**: see `deploy_sim2sim/` in the upstream repo (ROS 2 Jazzy + Gazebo Harmonic)
